answer: WITH fmi AS (SELECT interact_fan_pivot fid, AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric/NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) fmi FROM interactions GROUP BY 1), ev AS (SELECT m.member_fan_pivot fid, m.spending_profile, (COALESCE((x.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::numeric,0) + COALESCE((x.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::numeric,0)*1.5 + COALESCE((x.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::numeric,0)*2) eps, l.loyalty_snapshot->>'reward_tier' tier FROM membershipandspending m JOIN eventsandclub x ON x.events_member_pivot=m.member_reg LEFT JOIN loyaltyandachievements l ON l.loyalty_events_pivot=x.events_reg) SELECT f.nick_label, ROUND((ev.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric,2) total_spend_usd, ev.eps event_participation_score, ev.tier loyalty_reward_tier FROM fans f JOIN fmi ON fmi.fid=f.user_registry JOIN ev ON ev.fid=f.user_registry WHERE fmi.fmi>20 AND ev.eps>25 ORDER BY total_spend_usd DESC

WITH nps AS (SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot fid, (s.feedback_data->>'NPS_Val')::int nps FROM supportandfeedback s JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg=s.support_interact_pivot), mas AS (SELECT m.member_fan_pivot fid, c.merch_spend_usd::numeric / NULLIF((m.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric,0) mas FROM commerceandcollection c JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg=c.commerce_member_pivot) SELECT CASE WHEN nps.nps BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Platform Promoters' ELSE 'Detractors' END fan_segment, ROUND(AVG(mas.mas),2) avg_mas FROM nps JOIN mas ON mas.fid=nps.fid WHERE nps.nps BETWEEN 9 AND 10 OR nps.nps BETWEEN 0 AND 6 GROUP BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot fid, AVG(i.watch_hrs::numeric/NULLIF(i.sess_dur_min,0)) cci, AVG((i.chat_activity->>'Chat_Msg')::numeric/NULLIF(i.sess_dur_min,0)) cs FROM interactions i GROUP BY 1) SELECT e.cont_pref, COUNT(DISTINCT x.fid) engaged_lurker_count FROM x JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot=x.fid JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_activity_pivot=i.activity_reg WHERE x.cci>0.5 AND x.cs<0.5 GROUP BY e.cont_pref ORDER BY engaged_lurker_count DESC

WITH pss AS (SELECT m.member_fan_pivot fid, AVG(((p.usage_metrics->>'Int_Consist')::numeric + (p.usage_metrics->>'Plat_Stable')::numeric)/2) pss FROM preferencesandsettings p JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg=p.preferences_member_pivot GROUP BY 1), im AS (SELECT interact_fan_pivot fid, AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric/NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) fmi, AVG(watch_hrs::numeric/NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) cci FROM interactions GROUP BY 1), pss_r AS (SELECT fid, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pss) r FROM pss WHERE pss IS NOT NULL), fmi_r AS (SELECT fid, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fmi) r FROM im WHERE fmi IS NOT NULL), cci_r AS (SELECT fid, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cci) r FROM im WHERE cci IS NOT NULL), risk AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot fid FROM retentionandinfluence r JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg=r.retain_engage_pivot JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg=e.engage_member_pivot WHERE r.churn_flag='High') SELECT f.nick_label, ROUND(pss_r.r::numeric,3) pss_percentile, ROUND(fmi_r.r::numeric,3) fmi_percentile, ROUND(cci_r.r::numeric,3) cci_percentile FROM risk JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry=risk.fid LEFT JOIN pss_r ON pss_r.fid=risk.fid LEFT JOIN fmi_r ON fmi_r.fid=risk.fid LEFT JOIN cci_r ON cci_r.fid=risk.fid ORDER BY pss_percentile ASC NULLS LAST

WITH fmi AS (SELECT interact_fan_pivot fid, AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric/NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) fmi FROM interactions GROUP BY 1), eps AS (SELECT m.member_fan_pivot fid, MAX(COALESCE((x.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::numeric,0) + COALESCE((x.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::numeric,0)*1.5 + COALESCE((x.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::numeric,0)*2) eps FROM membershipandspending m JOIN eventsandclub x ON x.events_member_pivot=m.member_reg GROUP BY 1), cohort AS (SELECT f.user_registry fid, f.reg_moment::date reg FROM fans f JOIN fmi ON fmi.fid=f.user_registry JOIN eps ON eps.fid=f.user_registry WHERE fmi.fmi>20 AND eps.eps>25), days AS (SELECT c.fid, c.reg, d.n, c.reg + d.n AS day FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN generate_series(0,90) d(n)), daily AS (SELECT dy.fid, dy.n, dy.day, COALESCE(SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric),0) spend FROM days dy LEFT JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot=dy.fid AND i.time_mark::date=dy.day GROUP BY dy.fid, dy.n, dy.day), cum AS (SELECT fid, n, SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY fid ORDER BY day) cum_spend FROM daily), ms AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('7 days',7),('30 days',30),('90 days',90)) v(milestone,days)) SELECT ms.milestone, ROUND(AVG(cum.cum_spend),2) avg_cumulative_spend FROM ms JOIN cum ON cum.n<=ms.days GROUP BY ms.milestone, ms.days ORDER BY ms.days

WITH p AS (SELECT interact_fan_pivot fid, MAX((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric/NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) pmi FROM interactions GROUP BY 1) SELECT f.nick_label, f.user_registry, ROUND(p.pmi,2) peak_monetization_index, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.pmi DESC) fan_rank FROM p JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry=p.fid WHERE p.pmi>20 ORDER BY p.pmi DESC LIMIT 10

WITH s AS (SELECT m.member_fan_pivot fid, (s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric foll, (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric fing, e.engage_reg FROM socialcommunity s JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg=s.social_engage_pivot JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg=e.engage_member_pivot), r AS (SELECT r.retain_engage_pivot engage_reg, (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach')::numeric reach FROM retentionandinfluence r), x AS (SELECT s.fid, SQRT(s.foll*r.reach) cii, s.foll/NULLIF(s.fing,0) ffr FROM s JOIN r ON r.engage_reg=s.engage_reg WHERE s.fing>0) SELECT f.nick_label, ROUND(x.cii,2) community_influence_index, ROUND(x.ffr,2) follower_following_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY x.cii DESC) influence_rank FROM x JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry=x.fid WHERE x.ffr>2.0 AND x.cii>10000 ORDER BY influence_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sls AS (SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot fid, MAX(COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix')::int,0)+COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs')::int,0)+COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt')::int,0)) sls FROM supportandfeedback s JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg=s.support_interact_pivot GROUP BY 1), risk AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot fid FROM retentionandinfluence r JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg=r.retain_engage_pivot JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg=e.engage_member_pivot WHERE r.churn_flag='High') SELECT CASE WHEN risk.fid IS NOT NULL THEN 'At-Risk' ELSE 'Not At-Risk' END churn_status, CASE WHEN sls.sls>10 THEN 'High-Maintenance' ELSE 'Low-Maintenance' END support_status, COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_registry) fan_count FROM fans f LEFT JOIN sls ON sls.fid=f.user_registry LEFT JOIN risk ON risk.fid=f.user_registry GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH col AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot fid FROM commerceandcollection c JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg=c.commerce_member_pivot WHERE (COALESCE(c.dig_own,0)+COALESCE(c.phys_own,0))>50 AND c.coll_comp_rate>75) SELECT v.genre_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT col.fid) collector_fan_count FROM col JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot=col.fid JOIN virtualidols v ON v.entity_reg=i.interact_idol_pivot GROUP BY v.genre_tag ORDER BY collector_fan_count DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT m.member_fan_pivot fid, (s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric foll, (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric fing, e.engage_reg FROM socialcommunity s JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg=s.social_engage_pivot JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg=e.engage_member_pivot), inf AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.fid FROM s JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retain_engage_pivot=s.engage_reg WHERE s.fing>0 AND s.foll/s.fing>2.0 AND SQRT(s.foll*(r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach')::numeric)>10000), key_i AS (SELECT i.activity_reg, i.interact_idol_pivot, i.time_mark FROM interactions i JOIN inf ON inf.fid=i.interact_fan_pivot), other AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.activity_reg, o.chat_activity->>'Msg_Tone' tone FROM key_i k JOIN interactions o ON o.interact_idol_pivot=k.interact_idol_pivot AND o.time_mark BETWEEN k.time_mark - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND k.time_mark + INTERVAL '5 minutes' WHERE o.interact_fan_pivot NOT IN (SELECT fid FROM inf)) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone='Positive') positive_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone='Negative') negative_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone='Neutral') neutral_count FROM other
note: No two interactions share an idol within 5 minutes anywhere in the data, so every count is 0 whatever the influencer definition.
